：关节姿态、掌部关系、物体形状、26-link 的 5 mm 近邻标签与按物体尺: . It combines joints, palm-object relations, object shape, 5 mm proximity indicators for 26 hand links, and size-normalized distances. 这是 6,241 条 HOI reference 的单帧关系表示。三个 PCA: Each point describes one interaction configuration from 6,241 HOI references. PCA axes are scaled separately by their standard deviations for visualization; raw coordinates remain available in the point details. Proximity in this 3D view does not establish proximity in the full feature space. The E1 pose analysis below uses a separate population.
同一批样本，K=6；silhouette 与 ARI 描述聚类结构和重跑稳定性。: Same samples and K=6. Silhouette measures separation; ARI measures restart consistency. Object NMI measures association with object identity, not functional quality. /
代表取每簇距离中心最近的真实样本。左图为代表手形；右图为同簇 HOI 场景或距离: Each representative is an observed sample nearest its cluster center. Compare its hand pose with a recorded teacher interaction from the same final cluster; these are different frames and references. The C4 representative has no link within 5 mm of the object, so these groups should not all be interpreted as stable grasp types.

按 trajectory key 映射到最终簇，图片为保存 rollout 的: Scenes are mapped to final clusters by exact trajectory key. These are saved HOLD frames, not the configurations used for clustering; not every scene has passed strict success filtering.
原始数据集与最终簇的关系；SPIDER 中的 HOT3D、DexYCB、OakI: Dataset sources and final clusters. HOT3D, DexYCB, OakInk and HRDexDB entries processed through SPIDER are attributed to their original sources by reference key. /
成败来自已有 teacher 评测；表示与成功的关联不证明聚类带来了策略性能提升: Outcomes come from historical teacher evaluations. Correlation between representation and success does not establish that clustering improved policy performance. /
六类各一条，使用 General teacher: One example per final cluster, using General teacher
。腕部跟随 reference，手指由 teacher 闭环控制；统一白色桌面、: . The wrist follows its reference while the teacher controls the fingers. These color recordings are matched by complete reference identity and trimmed to the original display durations. Their original rollout measurements remain linked separately.
稳定 HOLD：末尾 30 个仿真 tick，物体抬升 ≥2 cm 且至少两根目: Stable tail HOLD: in at least 95% of the final 30 simulation ticks, the object is lifted ≥2 cm and at least two target-contacting fingertips reach 0.5 N. These are selected examples, not an aggregate success rate or a five-second HOLD evaluation.
最新 E1：1,029,112 个索引姿态中，1,015,044 个在 URDF: E1 indexes 1,029,112 poses, of which 1,015,044 satisfy URDF limits. A trajectory-key split and source-balanced sampling produce 8,867 fitting poses and 5,016 test poses. Sharpa uses 22 joint angles; the human analysis uses 60D hand-local landmarks normalized by hand length. These feature spaces are analyzed separately.
95% 方差维数受特征空间、数据范围和加权方式影响，不能直接解释为不同手的内在维: The component count for 95% variance depends on representation, population and weighting. It is not a ranking of intrinsic dexterity across hands. /
PCA-14 保留 96.1% 方差，但裁剪后指尖 FK 误差仍有均值 10.1: PCA-14 retains 96.1% of variance, yet fingertip FK reconstruction error after clipping still averages 10.1 mm, with a P95 of 26.7 mm. High variance retention does not guarantee precise contact geometry.
关节 RMS 为原始重建误差；指尖 FK 在关节限位裁剪后计算，超限率在裁剪前统: Joint RMS measures raw reconstruction error. Fingertip FK is evaluated after joint-limit clipping; limit violations are counted before clipping. /
所有最终 Bank 条目取自真实限位内姿态。KMeans 中心也替换成最近的真实: All exported bank entries are observed poses within joint limits. KMeans centers are replaced by their nearest training samples; approximate K-Medoids alternates over a candidate pool. Coverage is the mean of source-wise median nearest-pose errors, in radians. Diversity uses pairwise L2 distances after joint-range normalization.
K=6、12、24、48、96、192。不同规模继续改善覆盖；多样性增加不一定改: Bank sizes K=6, 12, 24, 48, 96 and 192. Larger banks improve coverage, but increased diversity alone does not guarantee better nearest-neighbor coverage. /
每次完整留出一个来源，13 个来源等权汇总；K=24 和 K=96。 ·: Leave one entire source out at a time, with equal weighting across 13 sources. Results shown for K=24 and K=96. /
原始姿态限位内比例；E1 已排除超限姿态。离线限位/FK 不等价于 PhysX: Fraction of sampled poses within joint limits. E1 excludes invalid poses; offline limits and FK do not validate PhysX self-collision or grasp success. /
SPIDER 来源只有约 10–25% 的抽样姿态通过当前 URDF 限位检查，: Only about 10–25% of sampled poses in some SPIDER source subsets pass the current URDF limit check; the cause remains unresolved. Exported bank entries have zero joint-limit violations, but their PhysX self-collision pass rate has not been established.
Link-near＋distance 的重跑 ARI 为 0.997，高于 ti: Link-near + distance has restart ARI 0.997, compared with 0.444 for fingertip + joint, and silhouette 0.087. Repeatable grouping does not establish functional grasp semantics.
K=24 时 Joint KMeans 的来源宏平均误差为 0.2263 rad: At K=24, Joint KMeans reaches 0.2263 rad source-macro coverage error versus 0.2597 rad for random selection, a 12.9% reduction. Coverage continues to improve at K=96 and K=192.
本轮 Medoids 没有超过 KMeans 的几何覆盖；两者最终都选真实姿态。: Approximate medoids do not outperform KMeans on measured geometric coverage. Both export observed poses. Execution quality still requires task and contact evaluation; it cannot be inferred from coverage curves.
历史 2026-10-18 PCA 报告与最新 E1 的采样、限位筛选和来源权重: The 18 October 2026 PCA analysis and E1 differ in sampling, limit filtering and source weights, so their values should not be combined into one trend. Historical reports remain in sources/. Current results are traceable to the bundled summaries and CSV files.
